ON_THE_WAY.title: Your order is on its way!
ON_THE_WAY.body: It left {store}. Have your payment and delivery code ready (it is in the order).

ARRIVING.title: Your courier is almost there
ARRIVING.body: Step out to get order {code} and have your delivery code ready.

PENDING_REVIEW.title: Your courier dropped off order {code}
PENDING_REVIEW.body: They left it with a photo. If you didn't get it, tell us from the order.

DELIVERED.title: Order {code} delivered
DELIVERED.body: Thanks for ordering with RapiChonta. Enjoy!

_.title: Your order {code} changed
_.body: Tap to see how it's going.

ORDER_OFFERED.title: New order for you
ORDER_OFFERED.body: {store} · tap to see it and take it.

OFFER_WITHDRAWN.title: Order {code} is no longer available
OFFER_WITHDRAWN.body: Another courier took it or it was cancelled.

PREPARATION_TIME_REACHED.title: Is order {code} ready?
PREPARATION_TIME_REACHED.body: The preparation time at {store} is up. Tap to answer.

ADJUSTMENT_REQUESTED.title: Your courier needs a decision
ADJUSTMENT_REQUESTED.body: Something in order {code} is missing or changed price. Reply soon.

ADJUSTMENT_RESOLVED.title: Order {code} has an answer
ADJUSTMENT_RESOLVED.body: See what stays on the list and carry on shopping.

INCIDENT_OPENED.title: The customer says order {code} didn't arrive
INCIDENT_OPENED.body: RapiChonta is reviewing your delivery photo. Keep your phone close in case we call.

RESOLVED_AS_DELIVERED.title: We reviewed order {code}
RESOLVED_AS_DELIVERED.body: It stays as delivered. Thanks for your patience.

RESOLVED_AS_CANCELLED.title: We reviewed order {code}
RESOLVED_AS_CANCELLED.body: We cancelled it. Tap to see the case details.

_.title: We reviewed order {code}
_.body: The case is closed. Tap to see how it ended.

DELIVERY_PROOF_PENDING.title: Delivery photo missing
DELIVERY_PROOF_PENDING.body: Take the delivery photo for order {code}.

TRIP_CANCELLED.title: Order {code} was cancelled
TRIP_CANCELLED.body: No need to buy it anymore. You are free for another order.
